properties.displayName: UAV S95 - Staged Bandwidth-Limited Split Exfiltration
properties.description: UAVExfilFlow_CL에서 StagingDirEvent=true 스테이징 이벤트 발생 후 30분 이내 동일 UAVId에서 ChunkCount>=10건, 청크당 2MB 미만(대역폭 제한 회피)으로 분할된 유출 흐름 탐지. MITRE: T1074 Data Staged, T1030 Data Transfer Size Limits
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 30m;
let minChunkCount = 10;
let maxChunkSizeBytes = 2000000.0;
UAVSatcomLink_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where PayloadBytes > 0 and PayloadBytes < maxChunkSizeBytes
| summarize ChunkCount = count(), TotalBytes = sum(PayloadBytes), MinTime = min(TimeGenerated), MaxTime = max(TimeGenerated)
    by UAVId, SessionId
| where ChunkCount >= minChunkCount
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("스테이징분할유출_", tostring(ChunkCount), "청크_합계", tostring(toint(TotalBytes/1000)), "KB_구간", tostring(datetime_diff('second', MaxTime, MinTime)), "초")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated = MaxTime, UAVId, SessionId, ChunkCount, TotalBytes, MinTime, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S95 - Staged Bandwidth-Limited Split Exfiltration - {{UAVId}}
